root_idea.summary: The root centers on moving something out of its proper position: putting it ahead, beyond its due place, or leaving it short of its proper measure.
root_idea.development: From this orientation develop meanings of precedence and hastening, excess and overflow, and conversely neglect or falling short. It also yields terms for those who go ahead, water reached first, advance markers, and a reward prepared in advance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed as the nominal headword فُرُطٌ.
Displayed under the singular passive-participial citation form مُفْرَطٌ rather than the Quranic inflected plural.

senses.definition: To hasten ahead against someone; to act precipitately toward him.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction فَرَطَ عَلَيْنَا, the action is understood as advancing against the addressees hastily, with injustice, harm, or threatened punishment. The broader idea of preceding is the lexical background, while the attested construction emphasizes hostile haste.

senses.definition: To neglect, fail in, or leave undone what one ought to do; to let a matter slip.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially with فِي for falling short regarding a matter, duty, or person. Quranic applications include neglecting what is recorded in the Book, failing regarding Joseph, and neglecting one's duty toward God.

senses.definition: Excess, extravagance, or transgression beyond due bounds.
senses.usage_conditions: In وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُ فُرُطًا, the expression characterizes an affair as exceeding the proper measure and, in some interpretations, as involving wrongdoing or transgression.

senses.definition: Neglect, waste, or disregard through failure to give a matter its due.
senses.usage_conditions: In the same Quranic expression, the word is also interpreted as an affair marked by neglected obedience, failure, or waste. This is a Quran-specific interpretation, not a general replacement for the sense of excess.

senses.definition: Sent ahead or dispatched first; hastened onward.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of those destined for the Fire, the form is interpreted as being sent or hastened there first.
The Quranic expression is also interpreted as leaving them in the Fire, forgotten or abandoned there. Other Quranic readings with different vocalization are not merged into this QAC form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To precede, go before, or have priority and precedence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general Form I use for a person or thing that gets ahead of others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go ahead of a company to the water and prepare the ropes, buckets, and watering place for them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use for the person who goes in advance to make watering arrangements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go beyond the proper mean or fall short of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in describing a position or conduct that is neither excessive nor deficient when negated; this is a lexical expression distinct from the Quranic noun فُرُطٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For speech or an action to proceed hastily, before reflection or without premeditation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of words, sayings, and actions that get ahead of deliberation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act hastily and unjustly toward someone; to do something harmful, disagreeable, or abusive to him; to revile him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A hostile transitive construction. It is broader as a Classical use than the specifically Quran-attested construction listed under فَرَطَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a palm tree to be left unpollinated until its spadix becomes dry and hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a well to be left until its water collects again.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use concerning the recovery of water in a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something precede; to send or put it forward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes sending a person ahead or in advance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To embolden someone in contention or altercation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send ahead while remaining behind; to leave, forsake, or abandon; to forget.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, thing, or affair. This Classical branch includes leaving something behind and allowing it to escape one's attention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave someone for a while or grant him delay and respite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of deliberately allowing someone or something to remain for a period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put away, remove, or avert from someone what he dislikes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relatively uncommon prepositional expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To praise someone immoderately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical use, reported as distinct from the more common neglect and forwarding senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or strive with others to precede, outgo, or outstrip them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or competitive use of getting ahead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find or come upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized synonymic use, distinct from competing to precede.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have a child or children precede one in death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when young children die before their parent, conceived as going ahead to the afterlife; it may also describe losing a child in early death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten, make something hasten, or advance before waiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, a hand reaching quickly for a sword, an affair, or a cloud bringing rain early.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed the due bounds; to act extravagantly or immoderately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair, love, hatred, praise, speech, or conduct, and also of doing more than one was commanded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To load someone or an animal beyond what he or it can bear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative use involving excessive burden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a water-skin, vessel, or watering-trough until the water flows over; to pour in abundant water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The overflowing result is part of the conventional use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a palm tree unpollinated until its spadix becomes dry and hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a horse to outgo or get before other horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V use describing a horse's advance over its competitors.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or strive with one another to precede or outstrip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI use; it may also simply mean to precede and make haste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For anxieties, affairs, or events to come upon someone successively, as though competing to be first.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use concerning repeated or successive occurrences at indefinite times.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the time of something to pass, become delayed, or be missed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a prayer whose time has passed, and of a desired matter that was not attained in time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be beyond being caught or to remain from passing away, of beneficence and kindness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed or highly idiomatic expression concerning benefits that remain available and do not become lost.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excess, extravagance, exorbitance, or an exceeding degree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for exceeding due bounds, distinct in form from the Quranic فُرُطٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mastery, ascendency, prevalence, or predominance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used, for example, of the overpowering force of desire or grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time or indefinite period; a while.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as meeting someone time after time or after a day or two; detailed temporal intervals vary by report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small mountain or the head of an eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An erect way-mark or object set up to guide travelers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural is used for the foremost landmarks of a desert.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person, or a group of people, who goes ahead to the water to prepare it for others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun on the فَعَلٌ pattern functioning like an active participle; it may refer to the water-seeker and preparer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A child who dies before reaching puberty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the child who has preceded the parent; the form may be singular or collective in this use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reward or recompense prepared in advance, and an act prepared in the same way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used in prayers for a child who has died, understood as a reward sent ahead for the parents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water reached in advance of other available water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of precedence in arrival.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An early sign or first foretoken of daybreak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually occurring in the plural expression أَفْرَاطُ الصُّبْحِ or أَفْرَاطُ الصَّبَاحِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Haste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concise nominal use distinct from the more specific person and water senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swift horse that precedes, outgoes, or outstrips other horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural form of the same lexical family is also used in related precedence expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eminence resembling a mountain, or the base of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun, distinct from the Quranic abstract use in وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُ فُرُطًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act of going forth or preceding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of single occurrence; it may also be used for an act of going out into a region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hasty or unpremeditated saying or action; forwardness and transgression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the expression for asking forgiveness for one's hasty acts, and a specialized use concerning religious overstepping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Going forth, preceding, or making repeated journeys.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person who travels frequently or goes out repeatedly into the country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Untractable, refractory, stubborn, or not readily made submissive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a camel or a man; the variant vocalization is also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water that belongs to whoever among several groups reaches it first.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of common water or a well where the first arriving party waters its animals without being crowded by the others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who precedes or goes before; a foremost member of a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes foremost sand-grouse that go first to a valley or water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who goes ahead to dig a grave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational or funerary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two stars that precede the stars of Banāt Naʿsh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative astronomical designation based on the idea of going ahead of a company.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Filled or full, especially of a pool left by a torrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical adjectival use distinct from the Quranic passive-participial interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exceeding due bounds; extravagant or excessive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person or to anything that exceeds a proper degree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The extremities or outermost parts of a country or similar region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural geographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Foremost in striving for eminence; possessing precedence in emulation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a laudatory expression about a person's pursuit of high rank.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Hasty speech is covered by the corresponding Form I lexical branch.
Precedence and haste are covered by the broader reciprocal competition meaning.
Specific interval examples are covered by the general temporal meaning.
The foremost sand-grouse use is covered by the general preceding-member meaning.

cautions: The interpretation of مُفْرَطُونَ in 16:62 has multiple transmitted explanations: being sent ahead, or being left or forgotten in the Fire. The displayed form is the QAC passive-participial form; related alternate Quranic readings are not treated as additional senses of this form.
